{#-
  Swap Tag — 4" × 2" landscape @ 300 DPI (1200 × 600 dots)
  ZD420 printer; labels feed with 4" as print width and 2" as length.
  ---------------------------------------------------------------
  Layout (left to right, three columns):
    Column 1 (x =   0 — 410): Brand / Model / Size / Color stack
    Column 2 (x = 420 — 720): Swap Price header + big price + MSRP (strike)
    Column 3 (x = 730 — 1200): Code 128 barcode + item_code text
  Fields pulled:
    doc.brand              → Brand value
    doc.custom_model       → Model value
    doc.custom_size        → Size value
    doc.custom_color       → Color value
    doc.custom_swap_price  → big featured price
    doc.standard_rate      → MSRP crossed out
    doc.custom_upc_helper / doc.item_code → barcode
-#}
^XA
^MNY
^LL600
^PW1200
^CI28
^FO10,20^A0N,22,22^FDBrand:^FS
^FO10,50^A0N,34,34^FB400,1,0,L,0^FD{{ (doc.brand or "")[:18] }}^FS
^FO10,115^A0N,22,22^FDModel:^FS
^FO10,145^A0N,34,34^FB400,1,0,L,0^FD{{ (doc.custom_model or "")[:18] }}^FS
^FO10,210^A0N,22,22^FDSize:^FS
^FO10,240^A0N,34,34^FB400,1,0,L,0^FD{{ (doc.custom_size or "")[:18] }}^FS
^FO10,305^A0N,22,22^FDColor:^FS
^FO10,335^A0N,34,34^FB400,1,0,L,0^FD{{ (doc.custom_color or "")[:18] }}^FS
^FO420,20^GB0,560,2^FS
^FO420,40^A0N,28,28^FB300,1,0,C,0^FDSwap Price^FS
^FO420,80^A0N,110,110^FB300,1,0,C,0^FD${{ "{:.2f}".format(doc.custom_swap_price or 0) }}^FS
^FO420,310^A0N,28,28^FB300,1,0,C,0^FDMSRP^FS
^FO420,360^A0N,40,40^FB300,1,0,C,0^FD${{ "{:.2f}".format(doc.standard_rate or 0) }}^FS
^FO490,380^GB160,0,3^FS
^FO730,20^GB0,560,2^FS
{%- set barcode_data = doc.custom_upc_helper or doc.item_code -%}
{% if barcode_data %}
^BY2,2,260
^FO760,80^BCN,260,Y,N,N,A^FD{{ barcode_data }}^FS
{% endif %}
^FO740,490^A0N,26,26^FB460,1,0,C,0^FD{{ doc.item_code or "" }}^FS
^XZ
